mapper.select: SELECT progress_id, user_id, sub_chapter_id, content_version_id, last_page_id, status, started_at, completed_at, updated_at FROM user_learning_progress WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND sub_chapter_id = #{subChapterId}

SELECT progress_id, user_id, sub_chapter_id, content_version_id, last_page_id, status, started_at, completed_at, updated_at FROM user_learning_progress WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND sub_chapter_id = #{subChapterId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO user_learning_progress ( user_id, sub_chapter_id, content_version_id, last_page_id, status, started_at, completed_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{subChapterId}, #{contentVersionId}, #{lastPageId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{status}, #{startedAt}, #{completedAt,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, #{updatedAt} )
mapper.update: UPDATE user_learning_progress SET last_page_id = #{lastPageId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, status = #{status}, completed_at = #{completedAt,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE progress_id = #{progressId} AND status != 'COMPLETED'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_learning_progress_events ( progress_id, user_id, sub_chapter_id, content_version_id, event_type, previous_status, status, previous_page_id, last_page_id, occurred_at ) VALUES ( #{progressId}, #{userId}, #{subChapterId}, #{contentVersionId}, #{eventType}, #{previousStatus,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{status}, #{previousPageId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{lastPageId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{occurredAt} )
